readout_other: diffusion kurtosis imaging (MK, Ka, Kr) at 3.0 T; BDNF immunostaining, H&E; neurological function score
direction_notes: Neuroprotective outcome: daily LITUS after controlled cortical impact attenuated the early rise and late fall of DKI mean kurtosis in cortex and prevented the thalamic MK rise, and raised BDNF staining scores; neuronal excitation or inhibition was not assessed.

exposures.label: LITUS to the CCI injury area

target.label: the injury area of the rat brain

timing.protocol_description: Stimulation duration 400 ms, tone-burst duration 0.5 ms, PRF 1 kHz; one trial lasted 3 s and 200 trials were evenly distributed over a total of 10 min, once daily from day 1 to day 42 after TBI. Unfocused transducer with a 10 mm collimator.

source_quotes.n_subjects: Rats in the LITUS group (n = 15) received the same operation to establish a moderate TBI model.
source_quotes.n_sessions_per_subject: LITUS was performed daily from day 1 to day 42 for rats in the LITUS treatment group (n = 15).
source_quotes.exposures[0].fundamental_frequency_khz: The ultrasound fundamental frequency (FF) was 500 kHz.

flags.reason: Three groups of 15 (sham, TBI, LITUS); only the 15 LITUS rats were sonicated.
Stated as daily from day 1 to day 42 (once a day for 6 weeks); 42 is read from the day range.
Paper says ultrasound was applied to the injury area (right parietal cortex, CCI site); no atlas region named. Thalamus was imaged but not targeted.
Resolved the burst rule from the stated TBD of 0.5 ms (SD 400 ms is the stimulus train); duty cycle not stated.
Isppa from a needle hydrophone; the paper does not say whether this is free field or through skull.
Only the MRI radiologists are stated to be blinded to group.
Transducer named as Olympus V301-SU; driven by Tektronix function generators and an ENI amplifier.
